mapper.select: SELECT IF (gender = 1,'男性员工','女性员工') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tlias.emp GROUP BY gender

SELECT (CASE WHEN job = 1 THEN '班主任' WHEN job = 2 THEN '讲师' WHEN job = 3 THEN '学工主管' WHEN job = 4 THEN '教研主管' WHEN job = 5 THEN '咨询师' ELSE '其它' END) AS pos, COUNT(*) AS num FROM tlias.emp GROUP BY job ORDER BY num

SELECT (CASE WHEN degree = 1 THEN '初中' WHEN degree = 2 THEN '高中' WHEN degree = 3 THEN '大专' WHEN degree = 4 THEN '本科' WHEN degree = 5 THEN '硕士' WHEN degree = 6 THEN '博士' END) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tlias.student GROUP BY degree

SELECT c.name, IF (ISNULL(t.data),0,t.data) AS population FROM tlias.clazz AS c LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT s.clazz_id,COUNT(0) AS data FROM tlias.student AS s GROUP BY s.clazz_id) AS t ON c.id = t.clazz_id;
